vb_textbox.text: Couple main things to look out for is the caps of the gnomes, keep an eye on their caps once you get a high yield from that gnome (curved or smooth caps) they will switch the yields back and forth between them. Another thing is to make sure that you click the basket even if you think you made a wrong choice. It's better to get some points rather than none at all. i missed the timing a couple times during it so make sure that you keep an eye on it.
